ownershipGroups.title: Historical record
ownershipGroups.short: Terminal tickets frozen before the Ownership taxonomy

routingRules: Every ticket belongs to exactly one ownership.
Route by the capability whose observable behavior changes, not by every file touched.
Split independently verifiable outcomes with different ownership into separate tickets.
Gates, deadlines, and work types are not ownership; ticket Ownership is assigned in delivery.ownership.
Bugs, documentation, tests, and technical debt are work types rather than ownerships.
Do not create miscellaneous, cleanup, or provider-specific ownerships.
Only terminal tickets frozen in historical-unclassified.txt may remain unclassified.
deliveryRules: Every open ticket belongs to exactly one delivery Track.
A Track title is a compact noun phrase; its outcome owns the full result sentence.
A Track is an ordered outcome chain across PRD execution sets, not a folder or Ownership bucket.
A Track's own order is its intra-Track dependency; only edges that order cannot express are authored in delivery.dependencies.
A Track is selectable when its first open ticket has no unresolved dependency; later cross-Track seams are visible but do not block the current ticket.
The first open ticket is the only next ticket used to calculate an available Track; independently, the User may claim any non-terminal ticket regardless of status, blockers, or Track position.
